{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_ranknet_advantage",
  "intuition": "A pairwise ranking loss inspired by RankNet that uses the advantage signals to weight the logistic loss of score differences, shifting from margin-based to probabilistic ranking paradigm.",
  "pseudocode": "prob = sigmoid(lpw - lpl)\nweighted_loss = -weight * advantage_gap * log(prob)\nloss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_probabilistic",

    "expects": ["log_prob_w", "log_prob_l", "weight", "advantage_gap"],

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    diff = lpw - lpl\n    prob = ops.sigmoid(diff)\n    loss = -ops.log(prob + 1e-12) * advantage_gap\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return loss.mean()"
}

{
  "name": "loss_ranknet_advantage_weighted",
  "intuition": "Use a RankNet-style cross-entropy loss that models the preference probability via a sigmoid on score difference, but weight the loss by the advantage difference to emphasize pairs with larger quality gaps, shifting from margin-based to probabilistic ranking with advantage-based weighting.",
  "pseudocode": "p = sigmoid(alpha * (lpw - lpl))\nloss_raw = - (advantage_w * log(p) + advantage_l * log(1 - p))\nloss = mean(weight * loss_raw)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_probabilistic",

    "link_family": "sigmoid",

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    import torch\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', torch.ones_like(lpw))\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))\n    score_diff = alpha * (lpw - lpl)\n    p = torch.sigmoid(score_diff)\n    # avoid log(0) by eps\n    eps = 1e-8\n    log_p = torch.log(p + eps)\n    log_1_p = torch.log(1 - p + eps)\n    loss_raw = -(advantage_w * log_p + advantage_l * log_1_p)\n    loss = (loss_raw * weight).mean()\n    return loss"
}

  "intuition": "This loss uses the pairwise cost gap preference signal with a logsigmoid link, but replaces the mean aggregation with a weighted median aggregation over the batch to reduce sensitivity to outliers and emphasize the median preference strength.",
  "pseudocode": "losses = -logsigmoid((log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * scale * cost_gap) * weight\nloss = weighted_median(losses, weights=weight)",
  "hyperparams": {

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    scale = float(extra.get('scale', 1.0))\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    x = (lpw - lpl) * scale * cost_gap\n    losses = -ops.logsigmoid(x) * weight\n    # Compute weighted median (fallback to median if no weight)\n    def weighted_median(values, weights):\n        sorted_indices = ops.argsort(values)\n        sorted_vals = values[sorted_indices]\n        sorted_w = weights[sorted_indices]\n        cum_w = ops.cumsum(sorted_w, 0)\n        cutoff = cum_w[-1] / 2\n        median_idx = ops.searchsorted(cum_w, cutoff, side='left')\n        return sorted_vals[median_idx]\n    loss = weighted_median(losses, weight)\n    return loss"
}
